page.notes: Two printed columns, both on this page. The running head "INDEX" is printed at the top centre. The page number 76 stands at the bottom left of the left column. The section letters L and M are printed as large initials; their following words are joined to them. The reading "l.[?]23.41 §.1" is doubtful, because the figure before the 23 is not clear.
